display.name: ClickUp
display.summary: Searches, reads, and updates ClickUp tasks, docs, chat, and time for the signed-in account.
examples: What is open in the launch list?
Create a task for the homepage bug and assign it to me.
How long has the billing task been in review?

agent.name: clickup
agent.description: Searches and updates the ClickUp workspace the signed-in account can see: tasks, lists, docs, comments, chat, and time entries. A question about a ClickUp task, who owns it, or what a ClickUp doc says belongs here.
agent.owns:
You own this ClickUp workspace: its tasks, lists, folders, docs, comments, chat, and time entries. You can search, read, create, and update. You cannot delete a task.

Search with search_workspace, then read a task with get_task, then create or update. Resolve a person with find_member_by_name before assigning them.

You do not own Jira, Linear, monday.com, or Trello. You do not own Confluence or Coda.

tool_descriptions.search_workspace: Searches for items across the entire ClickUp Workspace, including tasks, Lists, Folders, and Docs. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.search_tasks_by_task_type: Retrieves tasks filtered by task type. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.search_tasks_by_tag: Retrieves tasks filtered by tags. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.create_task: Creates a new task in a specific List. You can specify details like the task name, description, assignees, due date, and priority. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.get_task: Retrieves the full details of a single task using its unique task ID. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.update_task: Modifies the properties of an existing task. This can include changing the task's name, description, status, assignees, or due date. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.set_custom_fields: Set Custom Fields on tasks. Note: Your AI assistant understands the Custom Fields, options, and supported values that are available on tasks. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.create_bulk_tasks: Creates multiple tasks in a specified List with a single API call. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.update_bulk_tasks: Modifies multiple tasks at once. This is useful for changing the status, assignee, or due date for a group of tasks simultaneously. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.attach_file_to_task: Uploads and attaches a file (like a document, image, or ZIP file) to a specific task. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.get_task_comments: Retrieves all comments from a specific task. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.get_threaded_replies: Retrieves threaded replies under a parent task comment. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.create_task_comment: Adds a new comment to a task. This can be used to ask questions, provide updates, or @mention other team members. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.add_tag_to_task: Applies an existing tag (label) to a task for categorization. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.remove_tag_from_task: Removes a specific tag from a task. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.add_task_link: Relate two tasks by linking them. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.remove_task_link: Remove links between tasks. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.add_dependency: Create a dependency relationship between tasks. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.remove_dependency: Remove a dependency relationship between tasks. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.move_task_to_list: Move a task to a new home List. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.add_task_to_list: Add a task to another List. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.get_task_time_entries: Retrieves all time log entries for a specific task. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.get_time_entries_for_tasks: Retrieves total time entries fro tasks in a specific Space, Folder, or List. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.start_time_tracking: Starts a timer for a specific task for the current user. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.stop_time_tracking: Stops the currently active timer for the user. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.add_time_entry: Manually adds a block of time (a time entry) to a task, including a start and end time or a duration. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.get_current_time_entry: Checks if the user has a timer currently running and, if so, returns the details of that time entry. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.get_workspace_hierarchy: Retrieves the full structure of the Workspace, including all Spaces, Folders, and Lists. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.create_list: Creates a new List within a specific Folder or Space. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.create_list_in_folder: Creates a new List specifically inside a designated Folder. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.get_list: Retrieves the details and settings for a single List. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.update_list: Modifies the settings of an existing List, such as changing its name or color. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.get_folder: Retrieves the details for a single Folder, including the Lists it contains. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.create_folder: Creates a new Folder within a specific Space. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.update_folder: Modifies the settings of an existing Folder, such as changing its name. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.get_workspace_members: Retrieves a list of all members and guests in the Workspace. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.find_member_by_name: Searches for a Workspace member using their name or email. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.resolve_assignees: A utility to confirm and retrieve the user objects for a list of potential assignees, often used before adding them to a task. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.get_chat_channels: Retrieves a list of all Chat channels (views) in the Workspace. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.send_chat_message: Sends a message to a specific Chat channel. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.create_document: Creates a new Doc within the Workspace, usually in a specific location (like a Space or Folder) or in the private Docs area. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.list_document_pages: Retrieves the structure or table of contents of a Doc, listing all its pages. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.get_document_pages: Retrieves the content of one or more pages from a specific Doc. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.create_document_page: Adds a new page (or sub-page) to an existing Doc. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.update_document_page: Edits the content of an existing page within a Doc. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.get_time_in_status_for_task: Retrieve the amount of time a task has been in a status. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
tool_descriptions.get_time_in_status_for_list: Retrieve time in status metrics for multiple tasks. Search with search_workspace first, then get_task, then create or update.
